summary: Crown Reserve Acquisition Corp. I (a Cayman blank-check company) filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing Business Combination Agreement with Carvix, Inc. and its merger sub. The amendment revises Section 5.04 to align voting thresholds with its Fourth Amended Articles, requiring ordinary resolutions (simple majority of Class A and B shares voting together) for the business combination, Nasdaq, incentive plan, advisory organizational documents, and adjournment proposals. No terms, price, or premium were changed. The filing is a routine contractual amendment in a SPAC deal, not a new special-situation event. Watch for shareholder meeting and deal closing updates.
